items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: Pepper was particularly upset about a critical review that John Wilson had written about his performance with Monk

ctx.x: Good analogy. So I’m sitting here thinking how to respond to what you just said and I wonder if in all the interviewing that you’ve done, have you ever had a similar situation, who was interviewing someone who is approaching 80 and looking at the world at that time and suggesting a similar attitude. What would you have said to them?

Huh. Well I think about a conversation I had with Gil Evans right at the end of his life, or a conversation I had with Pepper Adams actually is more to the point, also at the end of his life. Pepper was particularly upset about a critical review that John Wilson had written about his performance with Monk and the review was in the New York Times and

it was pretty harsh and it really kind of ended Pepper’s opportunity to work with Monk, and he was just downcast thirty years later. The thing with Gil Evans is I don’t know how it came up but what he said in talking about his career, he said, “All I ever wanted was my certified fair share, CFS.” Certified Fair Share. And he said, “I don’t think I ever got it.” I think he’s talking about in terms of credit and in terms of commercial success. And he was really down in the dumps about that too. I don’t know if…
